_readme: The one source of colour, type and shape for both stacks. Edit THIS file, then run `node design/build-tokens.mjs`. It writes design/tokens.css (web) and android/app/src/main/java/ink/warrant/design/Tokens.kt (Android). Never edit those two by hand — they are overwritten.
_house: Warrant is built on Google's design language. Every colour below is a value from Google's own Material palette or the neutral ramps Google ships in Search, Gemini and Workspace. Nothing here is invented.

color._comment: Ground, dark — the workshop. Google's dark neutral ramp (Gemini / Search dark).
color._comment2: Ground, light — the paper record. Google's light neutral ramp (Workspace).
color._comment3: Ink for the paper side, and its dark-ground twin. Google Grey 900 / 700 / 600.
color._comment4: The action. Google Blue, and Google Blue only. No provenance class is allowed to be blue, because blue is what you press.
color._comment5: The four provenance classes. These are the product. Each takes a hue from Google's Material palette and each has a -lift variant for dark grounds.
color._comment6: Status, for StatusPill. Held is the one that matters — Google Red.

font._comment: Google Sans where the device has it — Android, ChromeOS, a Google laptop — and Roboto, self-hosted, everywhere else. Google Sans Code carries the machine role: it is a Google typeface, so the mono/sans provenance rule survives the restyle intact.

size._comment: Material 3 shape scale. Corners are the loudest single signal that a surface is a Google surface.

elevation._comment: Google's own shadow ramp, not a generic blur. Level 1 is a card at rest, level 2 a card lifted, level 3 a menu or a sheet.

motion._comment: Material 3 emphasized easing. Everything that moves on a Google surface moves on this curve.
